scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @fluxfast/core run build && pnpm --filter @fluxfast/next run build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @fluxfast/core run build && pnpm -r --if-present run test && pnpm test:release
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @fluxfast/core run build && pnpm --filter @fluxfast/next run build && pnpm --dir tests/browser/frontend run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:distributed: pnpm --filter @fluxfast/core run build && pnpm --filter @fluxfast/next run build && pnpm --dir tests/browser/frontend run test:e2e:distributed
scripts.test:e2e:production: pnpm --filter @fluxfast/core run build && pnpm --filter @fluxfast/next run build && FLUXFAST_BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3111 pnpm --dir tests/browser/frontend run build && FLUXFAST_E2E_PRODUCTION=1 FLUXFAST_E2E_PORT=3110 FLUXFAST_E2E_BACKEND_PORT=3111 pnpm --dir tests/browser/frontend run test:e2e:production
scripts.benchmark:runtime: PYTHONPATH=python/fluxfast/src:. ./.venv/bin/python benchmarks/scripts/benchmark_cross_page.py && PYTHONPATH=python/fluxfast/src:. ./.venv/bin/python benchmarks/scripts/benchmark_deferred.py && PYTHONPATH=python/fluxfast/src:. ./.venv/bin/python benchmarks/scripts/benchmark_live.py && PYTHONPATH=python/fluxfast/src:. ./.venv/bin/python benchmarks/scripts/benchmark_redis_cache.py
scripts.benchmark:codegen: pnpm --filter @fluxfast/core run build && pnpm --filter @fluxfast/next run build && node benchmarks/scripts/benchmark_codegen.mjs
